method: Lighthouse 13.4.1, default simulated mobile, local static export served with gzip compression on 4012. One lab run per route on each artifact; not production field data. Before-card-optimization reports use the same server and Lighthouse settings, before responsive card derivatives, CSS route splitting, CSS hero entrance and native card controls. Earlier 4010 reports used uncompressed responses and are not a controlled baseline. TBT is a lab responsiveness proxy; field INP remains unmeasured.
